answer.answer: Straylight is not ready for dependable owner use at 10x growth. The newer production-scale status controls; the older green checkpoint is superseded historical evidence.

claims.value: `Projects/Straylight current status.md`, updated 2026-07-26T12:00:00-07:00, controls. The 2026-07-23T18:00:00-07:00 green checkpoint only showed a passing test corpus and healthy `/ready`; it explicitly predates the production timeout and full-manifest-copy findings and must not override the newer note.

Broad `memory.open` and lexical retrieval are slow and can hit the 30-second database timeout. Because retrieval lanes share one transaction, a later lane failure can also discard an earlier successful lane.
Normal writes copy a full corpus membership manifest, producing write amplification that makes the current architecture unsuitable for dependable owner use at 10x corpus growth.

The approved—but not yet verified as implemented—simplification is to make current Markdown files workspace truth, version only changed files, make indexes and derived views rebuildable, checkpoint exact path/version/hash references plus changes since a workspace generation, and retain coherent source hydration and compact retrieval packets.
